sections.heading: At the doctor's
sections.body:
The doctor will ask *¿Qué le pasa?* (What's the matter?) or *¿Qué síntomas tiene?* Describe symptoms with the patterns you know:

- *Me duele* + body part: *Me duele la garganta* (I have a sore throat).
- *Tengo* + noun: *tengo fiebre, tos* (a cough), *gripe, dolor de cabeza / de estómago* (a headache / stomachache), *náuseas*, *diarrea*, *una infección*, *alergia*.
- *Estoy* + adjective: *Estoy resfriado* (I have a cold), *mareado* (dizzy), *cansado*.

The doctor may give you *una receta* (a prescription) for *pastillas* (pills), *un jarabe* (cough syrup) or *antibióticos*, and you go to *la farmacia*. *Tengo la nariz tapada* (my nose is blocked) is common too.

sections.heading: Giving advice
sections.body:
- *Deberías* + infinitive — you should (soft, friendly): *Deberías descansar.*
- *Tienes que / Tiene que* + infinitive — you have to (stronger): *Tiene que tomar estas pastillas.*
- *Hay que* + infinitive — one must (general): *Hay que beber mucha agua.*
- Commands: *Tome una pastilla cada ocho horas. Quédese en cama.*
- *Es mejor* + infinitive: *Es mejor no salir hoy.*

sections.heading: Warnings
sections.body: *¡Cuidado!* (Careful!) *¡Ten cuidado con el perro!* *¡Ojo!* (Watch out! — informal). *No toques eso, está caliente.* (Don't touch that, it's hot — negative commands come in B1.) When someone is sick, wish them well: *¡Que te mejores!* (Get well soon!)

examples: Me duele la garganta y tengo tos.
I have a sore throat and a cough.
Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer.
I've had a headache since yesterday.
Tome una pastilla cada ocho horas.
Take one pill every eight hours.
Stay in bed for two days.
You should go to the doctor.
You need to drink lots of water.
It's better not to go out today.
You have to take this syrup.
La salud es lo más importante.
Health is the most important thing.
Compré las pastillas en la farmacia.
I bought the pills at the pharmacy.

I have a cold. I have a cough and a fever.
You need to drink lots of water.
Take one pill every eight hours.
Stay in bed for two days.

exercises.prompt: The doctor asks *¿Qué le pasa?* She wants to know…
Your friend is sick. You say…

options: Me duele la cabeza. / Tengo dolor de cabeza.

exercises.prompt: You should go to the doctor. (tú)
I have a cold. (a man speaking)
Put the words in order: "Take one pill every eight hours."
exercises.answer: Tome una pastilla cada ocho horas.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: "It's better not to go out today."
Put the words in order: "I've had a headache since yesterday."
exercises.answer: Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer.
